content.text: {"cards":{"opening.3c76267fd4a5":["Ada clutched her invitation card in Quiet Cove. She wanted to deliver it to Mira before the pond concert, but Mira wanted quiet, not a noisy frog fanfare. At the pond, the water lay still, while Ben’s floating lily-pad stage waited unfinished and Frog practiced a very lively “RIBBIT!”","Ada had one important job: deliver the concert invitation to Mira. Yet Mira wanted quiet, and Ada had not guessed that. Across the still pond, Ben hoped to build a stage and Frog hoped to perform—loudly enough, perhaps, to wake a sleeping dragonfly."],"scene.learn_listener_wish.notice.e72ce7a203a6":["Ada noticed Mira’s wish for quiet."],"scene.deliver_card.1a6549413be1":["Ada placed the invitation card in Mira’s hands."],"scene.mark_delivery.eb4197ee95c7":["Mira received the invitation, and Ada’s delivery was complete."],"scene.respect_quiet.87e2e021f45e":["Ada paused. “No booming ribbits for Mira,” she decided. She chose to make room for quiet instead of assuming everyone wanted a noisy concert."],"scene.learn_pond_wind.notice.d65dfe980e44":["Ben looked across the pond and noticed that the water was still."],"scene.build_stage_still.b3034c6739ab":["“Still water—excellent!” said Ben. He fitted the lily pads together and prepared the floating stage without needing a ribbon or a tug-of-war with the pond."],"scene.learn_listener_wish.share.d2b81372e3fc":["Ada told Frog that Mira wanted quiet."],"scene.float_stage.23b08390e56c":["Ben nudged the ready lily-pad stage from the bank onto the still pond."],"scene.quiet_performance.68d8d9f7f4dc":["Frog lowered his lively voice to a soft ripple-song. Tiny rings spread from the stage, and Mira heard music gentle enough to leave the cove’s quiet undisturbed."],"ending.da96b0d209da":["Mira listened from Quiet Cove while the pond carried Frog’s soft ripple-song in silver circles. Ada stayed nearby, Ben’s stage rested on calm water, and no ribbon had to leave the bank. The invitation had opened a concert that sounded less like a shout and more like a secret tickle on the pond." ,"Mira listened as Frog’s soft ripple-song slipped across the still water. Ada’s invitation was delivered, Ben’s stage floated steadily, and Ada’s ribbon remained hers on the bank. Around the cove, little rings widened and faded, as if the pond itself were whispering, “Encore—quietly.”"],"opening.bd90405582b0":["Ada hugged an invitation card and dreamed of a pond concert with Mira in the audience. Mira wanted to join, but she had not yet received the invitation. At the still pond, Ben faced an unfinished lily-pad stage, while Frog warmed up with a grand, wiggly ribbit.","Ada wanted Mira to join the concert, so she carried an invitation through Quiet Cove. The card had not reached Mira yet, and the floating stage still waited on the bank. Luckily, the pond was still; unluckily, Frog was practicing a fanfare that made three reeds wobble."],"scene.learn_listener_wish.notice.d5b5c2dbc2b2":["Ada noticed that Mira wanted to join."],"scene.learn_listener_wish.share.7b8f05862c31":["Ada told Frog that Mira wanted to join the concert."],"scene.welcoming_performance.ac52a1ab3ee7":["Frog performed a lively chorus, bouncing bright notes across the pond. Mira heard it from the cove and joined in, bringing an eager clap and a grin wide enough for a whole lily pad."],"ending.28c2fba48741":["Mira joined Frog’s lively chorus as the still pond gleamed around the floating stage. Ada had delivered the invitation, Ben’s stage held steady, and Ada’s ribbon stayed on the bank. Frog’s final ribbit bounced from lily pad to lily pad while Mira clapped right on the beat—mostly.","The concert welcomed Mira with a lively chorus over the still pond. Ada’s invitation had reached her, Ben’s stage floated neatly, and the ribbon remained Ada’s. Mira joined with a cheerful clap, and Frog’s last note hopped across the water like a green pebble skipping three times."],"opening.3545f0941ba9":["Ada carried an invitation for Mira, who wanted to watch the pond concert. But Mira had not received it, and Ben’s lily-pad stage was still on the bank. The pond was calm, while Frog rehearsed a lively song that made even the cattails look curious.","Ada wanted to deliver an invitation so Mira could watch Frog perform. The card was still in Ada’s hands, and the stage was not ready. At least the pond was still. Frog puffed up proudly and announced, “My next note will be enormous!”"],"scene.learn_listener_wish.notice.ac9b103a92ae":["Ada noticed that Mira wanted to watch."],"scene.learn_listener_wish.share.dfc16b42da3f":["Ada told Frog that Mira wanted to watch the concert."],"scene.watching_performance.e78d78fa853e":["Frog softened his lively act into a gentle pond melody. Mira watched from the cove as the notes drifted over the water, each one small enough to fit beneath a dragonfly’s wing."],"ending.1676a5b37b04":["Mira watched Frog’s gentle pond melody from Quiet Cove. Ada’s invitation was delivered, Ben’s stage floated on the still water, and Ada’s ribbon stayed safely on the bank. The final note trembled across the pond, and Mira followed it with her eyes until it became a shining dot of sound.","Frog’s gentle pond melody gave Mira exactly what she wanted: a concert to watch from the cove. The invitation had arrived, the stage rested on calm water, and the ribbon remained Ada’s. Mira watched the last ripple widen beneath the moon-bright lily pads."],"opening.c6cd456bbbb4":["Ada wanted to deliver a concert invitation to Mira, who wanted quiet. That was tricky because Frog wanted a lively performance, and the pond’s breeze was already pushing at the water. Ben’s unfinished lily-pad stage sat on the bank, waiting for a clever plan.","Ada carried an invitation toward Mira’s quiet cove, hoping to deliver it before the concert. But the pond was breezy, Frog was lively, and Ben’s stage was not ready. Nearby, a loose lily pad skittered across the bank like it had somewhere important to be."],"scene.ada_to_pond.5ef3eca95697":["After delivering the invitation, Ada walked from the cove to the pond."],"scene.learn_pond_wind.notice.d7d2592ba0c2":["Ben noticed that the pond was breezy."],"scene.lend_ribbon.3c452364aecb":["Ada lent Ben her stage ribbon. “Use it to hold things steady,” she said."],"scene.move_ribbon.0fa97f25ac6a":["Ben carried Ada’s ribbon from the bank to the pond."],"scene.secure_ribbon.edffb6c9eae2":["Ben used the ribbon to secure the stage against the breeze."],"scene.build_stage_breezy.bcf9fe9d9bb9":["With the ribbon holding fast, Ben prepared the floating stage. It bobbed, but it did not scoot away like a lily-pad hat in a windstorm."],"ending.2dba5ecaa565":["Mira listened from the cove as Frog’s soft ripple-song crossed the breezy pond. Ben’s stage stayed tied down with Ada’s borrowed ribbon, Ada stood by the water, and Mira’s quiet wish shaped every note. The music arrived as tiny ripples instead of giant jumps.","The breezy pond carried Frog’s soft ripple-song to Mira without a single booming ribbit. Ben’s stage held firm with Ada’s ribbon, which remained with Ben for the moment, and Ada stayed at the pond. Mira listened while silver ripples curled around the tied-down lily pads."],"opening.30afe05c374d":["Ada hoped to deliver an invitation that would bring Mira to the pond concert. Mira wanted to join, but the invitation was still in Ada’s hand. Across the breezy water, Ben’s stage was unfinished and Frog waited with a lively song ready to leap out.","Ada wanted Mira to join the concert, yet Mira had not received the invitation. The breeze shoved little waves toward Ben’s unfinished stage, while Frog practiced lively notes. “I can sing louder than the wind!” Frog declared, which did not make the wind less interested."],"ending.02d487fcdf35":["Mira joined Frog’s lively chorus beside the breezy pond. Ben’s stage stayed secure with Ada’s ribbon, Ada stood nearby after delivering the invitation, and the wind turned every note into a dancing sparkle. Mira clapped, Frog sang, and the ribbon fluttered like a tiny red flag for the concert.","The breezy pond could not interrupt the lively chorus. Mira joined in, Ada watched from the water’s edge, and Ben’s stage held steady with Ada’s ribbon. Frog’s notes skipped over the ripples while Mira clapped along, making the whole pond sound as if it had found a second heartbeat."],"opening.09e1d265705d":["Ada carried an invitation for Mira, who wanted to watch the pond concert. The card had not reached her, and the breezy pond made Ben’s unfinished stage wobble before it even touched the water. Frog, meanwhile, prepared a lively song with very large ideas.","Ada wanted Mira to watch Frog perform, but the invitation was still undelivered. The pond breeze nudged the bank, Ben’s lily-pad stage waited unfinished, and Frog puffed out his cheeks. “This will be a lively concert,” he promised, while one loose leaf sailed past like a tiny audience member."],"ending.a38fee319e20":["Mira watched Frog’s gentle pond melody from the cove as the breeze combed the pond into silver lines. Ben’s stage stayed secure with Ada’s ribbon, Ada remained at the pond, and the delivered invitation had done its job. The final note floated by like a feather that knew where to land.","The breezy pond carried Frog’s gentle melody toward Mira, who watched from the cove. Ada had delivered the invitation, Ben’s stage held fast with her ribbon, and the music moved in small, shining ripples. Even the wind seemed to watch, pausing only long enough to lift one lily leaf."]}}
